Name: Better Shop Menu
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Changes the shop menu into a grid (can be disabled in the config file), and adds buttons to filter by category and sort by price/name.
Description:
**Better Shop Menu** changes the shop menu into a grid (can be disabled in the config file), and adds buttons to filter by category and sort by price/name.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
Just open any shop menu to see the new UI. Click the buttons in the bottom-left to sort/filter.

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/BetterShopMenu/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
